verdict.rationale: Weave records token usage and cost for each call and shows it in the trace tree and calls table. It also groups traces into Threads and sessions, so per-call cost can in principle be tied to a session. Nothing in the evidence shows custom metadata or attributes for tagging calls with user or feature identifiers, or aggregating cost by them. Missing for 10: documented custom metadata or attributes on calls, cost aggregation by user, by feature and by session, filtering or grouping cost views by metadata, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: Weave automatically records token usage and calculates cost for each call. Costs appear in the trace tree and in the calls table in the Weave UI.
Threads are collections of Traces related to a single session or conversation.
Weave organizes traces into sessions and turns from the ground up.
